name: MusicCast
summary: Control the volume and power of a Yamaha MusicCast device.
description: Lets Kalinka Player control a Yamaha MusicCast amplifier or receiver: its volume, its power, and switching it to the input Kalinka Player is connected to.

notes: Requires a Yamaha MusicCast device exposing the Yamaha Extended Control API on the local network.
Family-level coverage only; this catalog does not yet contain a verified exact-model list. Check the device's protocol support and configured zone and input.
Provides volume read/set, power on/standby, and readiness for Kalinka Player's configured input. Input switching targets that configured input; mute is not exposed.
